title: Add lifecycle state and recovery diagnostics
description: Expose actionable, truthful diagnostics that distinguish panel health, node connectivity, tunnel process state, probe results, retries, and recovery actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Each tunnel exposes state, last transition, last error category, retry count, and next recovery action without secret values
Dashboard/API state distinguishes panel health, node test result, process state, and protocol probe result
A failed or degraded tunnel offers a bounded retry/restart/recheck action and records the result
Diagnostic events are queryable through existing logs/events endpoints and remain localized in the UI

steps.description: Assert a failed runtime produces a sanitized diagnostic payload with state, error category, retry count, and action.
Add the smallest shared type/helper consistent with existing status/event APIs; avoid a breaking response change by adding fields or a compatible endpoint.
Publish diagnostics from engine lifecycle failures and reconcile results with bounded retention.
Update representative dashboard/tunnel views and both locale catalogs, then run typecheck/lint/custom tests.

technicalNotes: Never include command lines containing passwords, tokens, or private keys in diagnostics.
